comment: Policy engine vectors (docs/policy.md). Generated by `go test ./new/source -run TestPolicyVectors -update` from the hand-written cases in policy_vectors_test.go. Every implementation must reproduce `canonical` and `sourceId` for each valid input, reject each `reject` input with the class given, and evaluate each `eval` case to its `expect` (inputs are decoded fields, or a failed fetch; `tsMs` is the round timestamp). Every signed result is under `sourceId`: an inconclusive case signs its policy's `fallback` value.
